name: splice-equivalence-tests-are-code-only
body: The splice-equivalence suite covers the spec-only case alongside the code-only fixtures. `rust.project_cmd_e2e.e2e.merge_spec_only_lands_authored_rows_in_main_db` merges a spec-only change-set and asserts the merged authored rows reach main's DB; `rust.splice_e2e.e2e.spec_only_delta_cannot_diverge_from_full_rebuild` asserts a spec-only delta agrees with a full rebuild or is refused. The code-only tests `rust.splice_e2e.e2e.delta_application_matches_a_full_rebuild` and `rust.splice_e2e.e2e.spliced_and_full_rebuild_agree_on_every_table_count` run on `rust.splice_e2e.fixture_graph`, whose fixture builds only Module/File/Struct/Function/UnresolvedTarget with code rels, so both DBs carry empty authored tables and their authored-table equality is vacuous. `rust.project_cmd_e2e.e2e.merge_round_trip_start_mutate_verify_merge_rebuild` adds code and rescans the branch, exercising the code path.
